name: Authentic Italian Minestrone
steps: Dice onion, carrot and celery. Peel and cube the potato. Break broccoli and cauliflower into florets. Shred the cabbage.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrot, celery and rosemary for 5 min until softened.
Add tomatoes and crush them roughly with a spoon. Cook 3 min.
Add potato, broccoli, cauliflower and cabbage. Pour in stock and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20–25 min until all vegetables are tender.
Stir in cannellini beans and cook a further 10 min. Season well.
Ladle into a bowl and finish with grated parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.
